in_sanskrit.name: सुशील
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Absence of hostility or cruelty, innocence, friendly, unaggressive, tranquil, amicable, kind, benign, calm, gentle, mild, meek, peaceful, soft, sweet, unassuming, uncontroversial

in_hindi.name: सुशील

in_tamil.long_meaning: cutham (pure, innocent) + seykkal (doer), one who does good

in_telugu.name: శుశిల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: shadamainadesu (pure, innocent) + deśa (region, place), one who is from a pure region

in_marathi.name: Sushil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sushil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sushil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'shil' meaning rock or mountain. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is known for his calm and peaceful demeanor. The name signifies a strong, unwavering spirit, capable of overcoming any obstacle with grace and composure.
